app_materials: APPLICATION FORM OPENS ON JANUARY 1ST AND SHOULD BE SUBMITTED ONLINE: WWW.NATIONALLIFE.COM/OUR-STORY/GRANTS-AND-SPONSORSHIPS. WE LOOK FOR PROPOSALS THAT HAVE: - A WELL-PLANNED APPROACH TO UNDERLYING ISSUES OR NEEDS - A BASE OF SUPPORT - METRICS TO SUPPORT SUCCESS
app_deadlines: GRANTS- MARCH 31ST; SPONSORSHIPS- REVIEWED ON ROLLING BASIS UNTIL YEARLY FUNDING EXHAUSTED.
app_restrictions: OUR GRANTS VARY IN SIZE AND WE RARELY FUND AN ENTIRE PROGRAM. WE DO NOT FUND NEW PROGRAMS. WE INSTEAD FOCUS ON PROVEN PROGRAMS. WE ARE PRIMARILY FOCUSED ON PROGRAMS THAT HELP END CHILDHOOD HUNGER, ADDRESS CHILDREN'S MENTAL HEALTH AND TO A LESSER EXTENT, THOSE THAT SUPPORT COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT IN THE MONTPELIER, VT AND DALLAS, TX AREAS. THE VAST MAJORITY OF OUR FUNDING IS CENTERED ON CENTRAL AND NORTHERN VT AND THE DALLAS, TX AREA WHERE OUR EMPLOYEES LIVE AND WORK. FOR OUR GENERAL GRANTS PROGRAM, WE DON'T MAKE GRANTS FOR ENDOWMENTS, SCHOLARSHIPS, HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS, RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATIONS, LABOR AND FRATERNAL GROUPS, DEBT REDUCTION OR WORK THAT HAS ALREADY BEEN COMPLETED. ADDITIONALLY, WE DON'T MAKE GRANTS TO INDIVIDUALS, DAYCARE FACILITIES, OR FOR SCHOOL TRIPS. FINALLY, WE DON'T MAKE GRANTS TO ORGANIZATIONS THAT DISCRIMINATE IN ANY WAY ON THE BASIS OF RACE, RELIGION, GENDER, AGE, NATIONAL ORIGIN, DISABILITY, OR SEXUAL ORIENTATION.

name: LINTILHAC FOUNDATION INC
app_materials: ALL APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED ONLINE AT WWW.LINTILHACFOUNCATION.COM. APPLICATIONS SHOULD BE PREPARED TO DESCRIBE BRIEFLY: THE ORGANIZATION, ITS MISSION, ITS PRIMARY PROGRAMS, GEOGRAPHIC REACH, THE NEED IT IS SEEKING TO ADDRESS (INCLUDING KEY DATA POINTS AND SCOPE AND SEVERITY), THE NATURE OF THE REQUEST, HOW IT PLANS TO ADDRESS THE NEED, ACTIVITIES AND TIMELINESS, THE TOTAL FUNDING NEEDED FOR THE PROJECT, THE SPECIFIC FUNDING REQUESTED OF THE LINTILHAC FOUNDATION AND WHAT A SPECIFIC SITE VISIT TO THE ORGANIZATION WOULD REQUIRE.
app_deadlines: THERE ARE NO DEADLINES. GRANTS WILL BE AWARDED SEMIANNUALLY.
app_restrictions: GRANTS ARE MADE FOR EDUCATIONAL, SCIENTIFIC AND CHARITABLE PURPOSES. THERE ARE TWO CORE AREAS FOR GRANTMAKING TO ORGANIZATIONS SERVING THE STATE OF VERMONT: THE ENVIRONMENT - LIMITED TO ISSUES OF WATER QUALITY, CLEAN AND NUCLEAR-FREE ENERGY AND LAND CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT AND 2) MEDIA AND DEMOCRATIC ENGAGEMENT - LIMITED TO PUBLICLY SUPPORTED MEDIA AND CITIZENSHIP ENGAGEMENTS IN DEMOCRACY. REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM AND PLANT SCIENCES ARE ALSO AREAS OF FOCUS FOR GRANTS. UNSOLICITED PROPOSALS REGARDING LEGACY GIVING ARE NOT ACCEPTED NOR ARE PROPOSALS ACCEPTED FOR: INDIVIDUALS, EMERGENCY FUNDS, MUNICIPALITIES, CHURCHES, UNSOLICITED CAPITAL PROJECTS THAT FALL OUTSIDE THE CORE GIVING AREAS, OR WHEN ORGANIZATIONS HAVE SUBMITTED A PROPOSAL IN THE PRECEDING TWELVE MONTHS.
